messages.text: The audit found two uncovered defects despite the green suite: command-specific option validation was too permissive, and multi-digit `headers` alignment used the wrong tab stop. It also confirmed that tied frequency order varies between official processes, so I’m restructuring those tests to validate deterministic count order only; I’m adding empty-input and selector-error coverage at the same time, then rerunning the enlarged suite.
